welcome.tagline: Video player with real-time AI upscaling.
welcome.castBody: Hover a video in your browser and click NetsuCast, or use the extension icon (Alt+Shift+C). The video pauses there and carries on here.
welcome.dropHint: You can also drop a video file into the window.
welcome.mpvErrorHint: Run run.bat, then “Install / update player tools”, or set the mpv path in the settings.
welcome.warmupBody: Only once: after that, switching models is almost instant. You can already start a video.

scale.auto: Auto (×2, or ×4 when the screen is much bigger)

settings.title: Settings
settings.resumeHint: The video carries on where it was in the browser.
settings.fullscreenOnCastHint: The window goes full screen as soon as a video arrives.
settings.alwaysOnTopHint: Handy for watching in a corner of the screen.
settings.forceHint: Even when the video already fits the window: ArtCNN doubles the resolution, then the picture is scaled back to the screen, sharper and less noisy.
settings.scaleHint: Auto adds a second pass (×4) when the screen is still much bigger, for example a 540p video in 4K full screen.
settings.maxHeightHint: For YouTube, X and the sites read by yt-dlp.
settings.debandHint: Removes the colour bands of heavily compressed streams.
settings.subLangsHint: Codes separated by commas, for example en,fr. Empty: never turned on by default.
settings.autoSubsHint: YouTube: subtitles generated by the platform.
settings.audioLangsHint: Codes separated by commas, for example ja,en.
settings.hwdecHint: Turn off if the picture shows artefacts.
settings.portHint: The same in the extension and here.
settings.resetModelsHint: Do this if the picture freezes for a long time when you switch models.
settings.resetModelsDone: The models will be prepared on the next launch.
settings.restartNote: Some changes apply on the next launch.
settings.portBusy: Port {{port}} is taken by another program: pick another one, here and in the extension.

errors.ytBotWithCookies: YouTube refuses playback despite your session. Check that you're signed in to YouTube in your browser, then try again.
errors.ytBotNoCookies: YouTube wants your session (bot check), but no cookie came through: {{detail}}.
errors.detailNotExtension: the cast didn't come from the extension
errors.detailCookieError: the browser refused access to cookies ({{error}})
errors.unsupported: Site not recognised: start the video on the page, then cast it with the NetsuCast button.

install.title: Install the NetsuCast extension
install.step3: In the window that opens, paste the path (Ctrl+V) into the address bar at the top, press Enter, then click “{{select}}”.
install.waiting: NetsuCast is waiting for the extension…
install.installed: Extension installed. The NetsuCast button now shows on videos.
install.whereLeftBottom: in the left menu, at the bottom
install.whyManual: Browsers don't let an extension install itself: these three clicks are needed once.

update.failed: Can't install the update. Try again later.
